name: extrachain-contracts-as
description: Independent AssemblyScript SDK and components for ExtraChain contracts.

scripts.build:basic: npm run generate:basic && asc assembly/.exco/index.ts --outFile build/basic.wasm --runtime stub --disable bulk-memory --use abort=assembly/.exco/index/contractAbort --optimizeLevel 3 --shrinkLevel 1 && node scripts/mark-wasm.mjs build/basic.wasm assemblyscript
scripts.build:router-test: asc examples/router-conformance/assembly/index.ts --outFile build/router-conformance.wasm --runtime stub --disable bulk-memory --use abort=examples/router-conformance/assembly/index/contractAbort --optimizeLevel 3 --shrinkLevel 1 && node scripts/mark-wasm.mjs build/router-conformance.wasm assemblyscript
scripts.build:dfs: asc examples/dfs-binding/assembly/index.ts --outFile build/dfs-binding.wasm --runtime stub --disable bulk-memory --use abort=examples/dfs-binding/assembly/index/contractAbort --optimizeLevel 3 --shrinkLevel 1 && node scripts/mark-wasm.mjs build/dfs-binding.wasm assemblyscript
scripts.build:fungible: asc fungible-token/assembly/index.ts --outFile build/fungible-token.wasm --runtime stub --disable bulk-memory --use abort=fungible-token/assembly/index/contractAbort --optimizeLevel 3 --shrinkLevel 1 && node scripts/mark-wasm.mjs build/fungible-token.wasm assemblyscript
scripts.build:nft: asc non-fungible-token/assembly/index.ts --outFile build/non-fungible-token.wasm --runtime stub --disable bulk-memory --use abort=non-fungible-token/assembly/index/contractAbort --optimizeLevel 3 --shrinkLevel 1 && node scripts/mark-wasm.mjs build/non-fungible-token.wasm assemblyscript
scripts.build:example-token: node scripts/generate-contract.mjs examples/token-x/assembly/contract.ts && asc examples/token-x/assembly/.exco/index.ts --outFile build/example-token-x.wasm --runtime stub --disable bulk-memory --use abort=examples/token-x/assembly/.exco/index/contractAbort --optimizeLevel 3 --shrinkLevel 1
scripts.build:example-nft: node scripts/generate-contract.mjs examples/nft-collection/assembly/contract.ts && asc examples/nft-collection/assembly/.exco/index.ts --outFile build/example-nft-collection.wasm --runtime stub --disable bulk-memory --use abort=examples/nft-collection/assembly/.exco/index/contractAbort --optimizeLevel 3 --shrinkLevel 1
scripts.check: npm run build:basic && npm run build:router-test && npm run build:dfs && npm run build:fungible && npm run build:nft && npm run build:example-token && npm run build:example-nft
